items.title: Project developers can now sign up for Verra’s Scope 3 registry
items.summary: The world’s largest issuer of voluntary carbon market credits is gearing up to launch a registry for an emerging type of credit that’s used to decarbonize supply chains.

items.title: Busting the myth that newer carbon credits are superior
items.summary: The opinions expressed by Trellis expert contributors are their own, not those of Trellis . Companies often try to buy relatively new carbon credits, sometimes those no more than five years old.

items.title: Report: UK clean energy transition faces £511bn investment challenge by 2040
items.summary: The UK will need at least £511bn of investment between 2026 and 2040 to deliver its clean energy transition, according to a report commissioned by Standard Life and Santander.

items.title: CCC warns Heathrow expansion has no credible climate pathway under current policies
items.summary: Heathrow Airport expansion cannot be reconciled with the UK's climate commitments under current policies, according to advice from the Climate Change Committee (CCC).

items.title: How to cut through the noise at New York Climate Week
items.summary: Happening on 20-27 September, Climate Week NYC is just around the corner.

items.title: 45-minute Masterclass: Making Scope 3 actionable: Scaling renewable electricity across the value chain
items.summary: Event Date: 03/11/2026 | 1:00 pm UK | 8:00 am US East Coast ET | 5:00 am US West Coast PT | 2:00 pm Central Europe CET/CEST Join the edie webinar on 3 November 2026 to learn how to make Scope 3 emissions actionable by scaling renewable electricity across your value chain.

items.title: ONE DAY to go until edie’s Sustainable Supply Chains Summit
items.summary: Join us on 17 September for a unique opportunity to gain expert-led insights through thought leadership and industry panels featuring top professionals in sustainability, supply chain and procurement.

items.title: From Nepal to corporate boardrooms: The climate cases reshaping accountability
items.summary: The Paris Agreement set a global benchmark for climate action. Now, courts are wrestling with who must pay when that benchmark is missed.

items.title: EU truck manufacturers call for adjusted compliance time for EV production
items.summary: Leading truck manufacturers across Europe have stated that the shift to zero-emission heavy-duty vehicles is at risk due to poor charging and refuelling infrastructure, grid connections and high energy prices.

items.title: edie 27 launches Climate Resilience & Nature Zone as demand for adaptation and resilience solutions accelerates
items.summary: As climate risks intensify, nature loss accelerates and disruption becomes a growing reality for organisations, businesses are under pressure to adapt faster, protect operations, manage risk and build long–term resilience.
